query:
SELECT 'senate' as chamber, state_code, state_name, status, called_winner, DATE(updated_at) as updated_date FROM senate_races WHERE called_winner IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'house', state_code, state_name, status, called_winner, DATE(updated_at) FROM house_races WHERE called_winner IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'governor', state_code, state_name, status, called_winner, DATE(updated_at) FROM governor_races WHERE called_winner IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY chamber, state_code;
